svg.title: HPC Supercomputer Architecture - 1000+ Distributed Node Fabric
svg.desc: Massively parallel HPC supercomputer architecture visualization showing Slurm orchestration tier, high-speed 800 Gbps non-blocking interconnect fabric, 1,000+ distributed CPU and GPU compute nodes, and multi-TB/s parallel storage tier.
svg.text: HPC SUPERCOMPUTER ARCHITECTURE :: 1,000+ DISTRIBUTED NODES :: NON-BLOCKING FABRIC
